steps: Cook Rice according to package directions; set aside and keep warm.
Peel and finely dice Onion, mince Garlic, and slice Carrot (cooked) into small rounds.
Cut Chicken into small bite-sized cubes, no larger than 1 cm.
Heat Olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, about 180 °C (350 °F).
Add Onion and Garlic; cook for 3 minutes, stirring, until softened and translucent.
Add Chicken and Turmeric; cook for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until no pink remains.
Add Carrot (cooked), Green peas and Unsalted chicken broth; simmer 4 to 5 minutes, until peas are tender.
Stir in Lemon juice and remove from heat.
Spoon the pea and chicken mixture over Rice in shallow bowls.
Serve 4 family portions immediately; refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 2 days.
